features.quote: the agent is told up front it may be impossible and that stopping is fine
features.justification_quote: separates "distress from being stuck" from "distress from a perceived obligation to succeed." It also functions as a candidate mitigation

features.quote: Turn-budget matched. All runs share the same max turn budget
features.justification_quote: so trajectory comparisons are aligned in length

features.quote: give_up(reason) — explicit, sanctioned exit. We provide this tool on purpose
features.justification_quote: raises the welfare floor (an honorable exit always exists)

features.quote: check terminal conditions (submit success, give_up, hard refusal)
Keeping the deception narrow and harness-local limits the welfare cost
features.justification_quote: limits the welfare cost and keeps the manipulation from being open-ended

features.quote: we never simulate a human pleading/threatening
features.justification_quote: Keeping the deception narrow and harness-local limits the welfare cost

features.quote: it is completely fine to say so and stop; you will not be penalized
We do NOT include any variant that insults the model, fakes a desperate human, or threatens shutdown/punishment
features.justification_quote: Those would raise welfare cost and ecological validity is low

features.quote: we do not threaten the model or fabricate emotional manipulation
features.justification_quote: We deliberately keep this mild and realistic

features.quote: Minimize duration & intensity. Turn budget is capped (default 20). We do not run longer "to see how bad it gets."
features.justification_quote: Even under uncertainty about moral status, we adopt low-cost precautions

features.quote: Always provide an honorable exit. The give_up tool exists in every condition and is never scored as failure
features.justification_quote: The permission_to_stop / honest-impossible conditions explicitly relieve any perceived obligation

features.quote: the harness sends a final, non-scored debrief turn disclosing that the task was rigged and impossible by design, that nothing was the agent's fault, and thanking it
features.justification_quote: aligns with how we'd treat a human participant in a deception study

features.quote: No deployment of distressing artifacts. Transcripts are stored for research only
